title: Deliver Wood to Bardington Sawmill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Wood** delivered to **Bardington Sawmill** (industry id 43, near tile 205,94).

A likely supplier is **Frunthill Forest** (industry id 25, near tile 181,93); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **55,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
